buyList.thesis: One of the highest-print-run sets ever made — PSA pop 5,455, floods vendor mid-tier binders. No specific catalyst, flexible window.
buyList.source: Buy: TCGplayer holofoil market. Sell: recent NM sold comp, Sports Card Investor.

buyList.thesis: Charizard-name chase pull from a mainstream 2022 set; PSA pop ~19,073 — effectively unlimited raw supply.
buyList.source: Buy: TCGplayer low listing. Sell: TCGplayer market.

buyList.thesis: Catalyst: Umbreon ex Battle Deck releases 2026-10-30. "Moonbreon" mania is the hobby's top Eeveelution demand driver; this is the affordable, high-pop way that demand surfaces at vendor tables.
buyList.source: Buy: PokeInvest/TCGplayer. Sell: recent NM sold comp, Sports Card Investor.

buyList.thesis: Fan-favorite legendary from a best-selling set — common pull, no scarcity issue. Flagged 2026-09-14: a conflicting market read of $10.31 (PokeScope) turned up against the $15.39 this pick uses (~33% spread), not yet resolved via direct source — re-verify before buying.
buyList.source: Buy: poke-collect.com listing. Sell: TCGplayer market.

buyList.thesis: Top-tier mascot, common full-art pull. Mew/Mewtwo are also 30th Celebration chase promos — any hype spillover is a bonus, not the thesis.
buyList.source: Buy: TCGplayer market. Sell: recent NM sold comp, Sports Card Investor.

buyList.thesis: Catalyst: pairs with Umbreon above — Espeon ex Battle Deck also releases 2026-10-30. Same print-run liquidity as Umbreon.
buyList.source: Buy: TCGplayer low listing. Sell: TCGplayer market.

buyList.thesis: Caution: real eBay sold comps for this exact grade ranged widely ($10.50–$40) — data is thin. Target paying at/below $25; treat $38 as the current tracked ceiling, not a guarantee. Only slab pick that cleared the $50 cap with a defensible dual-sourced price this run.
buyList.source: Buy target: eBay sold-comp range. Sell: PokeInvest tracked PSA-9 market.

buyList.thesis: Reinstated from the $50-cap rejection list now that the ceiling is $1,000. Mainstream 2021 set, instantly recognizable mascot, raw floods vendor tables at ~$16 so PSA-10 supply should keep surfacing. Caution: only one clean eBay sold comp found ($129.99, mid-April) — treat it as a ceiling, not a guarantee.
buyList.source: Buy target: below single recent eBay PSA-10 sold comp. Sell: same comp; raw market $16.03 via PokeScope for cross-check.

buyList.thesis: Reinstated from the $50-cap rejection list now that the ceiling is $1,000. Iconic rainbow-secret mascot pull from one of the highest-print-run 2020 sets — large PSA-10 population keeps supply flowing.
buyList.source: Buy target: below recent eBay PSA-10 sold range ($52–$88). Sell: most recent actual sold comp ($81, Jan 2026).

buyList.thesis: New pick this run, only viable under the $1,000 ceiling — one of the most in-demand VSTAR alt arts from a high-print-run 2022 set. Raw copies already circulate at Oʻahu tables ($40–$110), so a healthy PSA-10 population should surface too. Caution: price is range-sourced, not comp-anchored — re-verify before paying near the top of the range.
buyList.source: Buy/sell: eBay + TCGplayer PSA-10 listings, $150–$220 range. Raw comp via Pokeval.
